front: Compare cohort, case-control, and cross-sectional studies.
why: Cohort vs case-control vs cross-sectional is tested on essentially every exam

front: Contrast experimental and observational study designs.
why: Experimental vs observational and causation vs association is a yearly staple

front: What is external vs. internal validity?
why: Internal vs external validity (generalizability) is commonly tested in P/S

front: What is recall bias and which design is vulnerable?
why: Recall bias in case-control designs is a standard bias question
Selection bias is one of the most frequently named threats to validity
Hawthorne effect is a commonly tested named observer effect
Placebo effect and its control by blinding recur in passage design questions
Peer review is a scientific-process concept; rarely the point a question turns on
